description: Finds the RBI Master Directions for non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) held in this dataset by topic, reference number or category, with the RBI reference, date, summary and links to the page and the PDF. Use for NBFC regulatory-compliance questions, e.g. which direction governs fair practices, KYC, provisioning or registration.

category.description: Category: registration = Registration & Structure; governance = Governance & Compliance; prudential = Prudential Norms; credit = Credit & Lending; risk = Risk Management; disclosure = Disclosure & Reporting; consumer = Consumer Protection; specialised = Specialised NBFCs

query.description: Topic or RBI reference, e.g. "fair practices code", "KYC", "RBI/DOR/2025-26/339"

name: find_rbi_nbfc_direction
title: Find RBI NBFC Master Direction
